projects.name: Corsicana Facility
projects.quote: Phase 1 of the Corsicana Facility development is comprised of the buildout of an initial 400 MW of immersion-cooled data center infrastructure.

projects.name: Rockdale Facility
projects.quote: Bitcoin Mining revenue in excess of Bitcoin Mining cost of revenue for the quarter was $6.8 million (22% of mining revenue), as compared to $7.4 million (33% of mining revenue) for the same three-month period in 2022, a decrease of $0.6 million driven by higher labor costs due to the expansion of the Rockdale facility.
